Name: Duration
Description: Controls how long erosion runs. Longer durations produce more elaborate terrain reshaping, while shorter durations help preserve original forms.

Name: Downcutting
Description: Governs how deeply water cuts into the terrain, carving valleys and channels.

Name: Erosion Scale
Description: Sets the overall size of erosion features, from fine gullies to massive ravines.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomizes the erosion pattern while keeping other settings the same.

Name: Sediment Discharge
Description: Defines how different sediment types are transported and deposited during erosion.

Name: Suspended Load
Description: Fine, light sediments that travel far and fill gullies with subtle detail.

Name: Discharge Angle
Description: Sets the slope at which suspended load settles.

Name: Bed Load
Description: Heavier sediments like gravel that fill and shape gullies and slopes.

Name: Discharge Angle
Description: Sets the slope angle for bed load deposition.

Name: Coarse Sediments
Description: The heaviest materials (boulders, scree) that deposit on steep slopes.

Name: Discharge Angle
Description: Controls the slope threshold for coarse sediment settling.

Name: Shape
Description: Enables artistic control over how erosion reshapes terrain.

Name: Shape
Description: Balances between preserving the original shape and allowing natural reshaping.

Name: Shape Sharpness
Description: Defines how sharp or concave ridges become after erosion.

Name: Shape Detail Scale
Description: Sets the scale of simulated details, from broad ravines to fine gullies.

Name: Orographic Influence
Description: Controls how rainfall-driven erosion is applied across terrain features.

Name: Enable
Description: Toggles orographic influence on or off.

Name: Directional Precipitation
Description: Simulates rain falling more intensely from one direction to create rain shadows.

Name: Direction
Description: Sets the direction from which rainfall comes most strongly.

Name: Rain Shadow
Description: Controls how strongly terrain blocks rainfall from certain directions.

Name: Slope
Description: Limits rainfall effects to specific elevation ranges.

Name: Altitude
Description: Limits rainfall effects to specific slope ranges.

Name: Reverse
Description: Inverts the influence mask for creative control.
